item.title: 用于从头算量子化学的神经网络量子态扩展
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chenxi Yu, Hanlin Kong, Jianan Wei, Lizhong Fu, Honghui Shang, Wenguan Wang 等7位作者
神经网络量子态能够在不显式枚举行列式空间的情况下表示多电子波函数，但其精度同时取决于模型规模和变分优化投入。本文基于两个六分子源基准，系统考察了八种模型规模和五个优化阶段下二者对能量误差及计算成本的共同影响，并提出交互缩放定律以刻画这种耦合关系。所得误差—计算量帕累托前沿可用于在给定计算预算内联合选择模型规模和优化步数；该有利的缩放趋势在留出氮分子上的微调中也得以保持。

item.title: 基于密度泛函理论计算与机器学习势重新审视体心立方金属中位错滑移的量子效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Arnaud Allera, Lisa Ventelon, Mihai-Cosmin Marinica, David Rodney, Laurent Proville
本文利用密度泛函理论和机器学习原子间势重新研究低温下体心立方金属位错滑移中的量子效应。结果表明，量子效应确实会影响低温位错滑移，但其幅度远低于先前报道的结果，无法解释原子尺度塑性流动模型与实验之间的差异。研究因此重新提出了晶体基本性质预测性原子模拟中的一个长期问题。

item.title: 通过动态谱优化预测外延SrTiO₃/Si忆阻器中的氧空位动力学的物理信息神经网络替代模型
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Rodion Podorozhny, Nikoleta Theodoropoulou, Jelena Tešić
本文提出一种级联物理信息神经网络架构，并结合定制的二阶第二类切比雪夫多项式谱优化器DSO V2 Hybrid，用于模拟Pt/SrTiO₃/Si忆阻异质结构中的离子-电子漂移扩散输运。通过将电势、载流子密度和空位输运分配给四个依次训练的子神经网络，该模型在不采用算子分裂的情况下处理了超过10¹⁶的条件数。训练后的替代模型能够重现实验导电原子力显微镜电流-电压滞回特性，R²大于0.96，同时保持连续空间中的严格泊松一致性；与传统有限元求解器相比，它支持可微分的逆参数估计，并实现线性时间推理。

item.title: Beyond DFT: Quantum Chaos and Neural Networks for 2D Material Device Design
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Shahram Mehrmanesh, Sohrab Behnia
Accurate prediction of quantum stability in Selenium-doped MoS 2 field-effect transistors (FETs) remains challenging due to the computational cost of ab initio methods. Here, we combine quantum chaos theory with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural network to predict the Brody parameter (β) and current-voltage characteristics without relying on density functional theory. Our MLP model achieves R 2 > 0.93 on test data, accurately capturing the dependence of quantum chaos on bias voltage, impurity concentration, and lattice size. We demonstrate that quantum stability is tunable, not intrinsic, and uncover a universal scaling law where system size governs the transition from integrable to chaotic behavior. This framework bridges atomistic theory and device engineering, enabling rapid design…

item.title: 通过机器学习与实验验证揭示金属纳米团簇-N4C电催化剂的活性描述符
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Arupjyoti Pathak, Srijib Das, Mukaddar SK, Tapas Kuila, Om Jadhav, Samrit Kumar Maity 等8位作者
金属纳米团簇的催化机理难以解释，因为每增加或移除一个原子，其性质都可能发生显著变化。本文结合高通量密度泛函理论筛选和机器学习电子描述符分析，研究了负载于氮掺杂石墨烯上的62种地球丰产金属纳米团簇，并将Ni19@N4C确定为最具活性的析氧反应催化剂，理论过电位为0.39 V。随机森林回归模型表现最佳，d带前沿向下为主要电子描述符；实验合成的NiNC@NGC催化剂获得了460 mV的校正过电位和94 mV dec−1的Tafel斜率，接近商业RuO2的性能。

item.title: SENTINEL-RL: Offloading Topological Reasoning from LLM Agents in the Security Operations Center
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Uday Vallabhaneni, Cassie L. Cagwin, David J. Wild
arXiv:2609.04159v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed as autonomous SOC analysts, but two limitations make them unreliable at enterprise scale: a finite context window cannot hold a multi-thousand-host authentication graph, and free-form generation offers no guarantee that a recommended containment action is consistent with the topology it operates on. item.title: 量子光学自旋玻璃或可改善人工智能的记忆与学习方式
item.description:
📚 Physics News
一项新研究证明，可以构建由原子和光子组成的网络，从而改善人工智能存储和回忆记忆的能力。该网络被称为量子光学自旋玻璃，可作为联想记忆系统，根据部分信息恢复完整记忆，类似于人类从模糊照片中辨认人脸。

item.title: SALTED: a symmetry-adapted machine-learning program for predicting electron-densities in molecules and materials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zekun Lou, Alan M. Lewis, Théophane Bernhard, Lukas Seifert, Agustin Salcedo, Florian Kleemiss 等8位作者
arXiv:2609.03576v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: SALTED provides an open-source Python package for machine learning the quantum-mechanical electron density, n(r), in molecular and condensed-phase systems based on input atomic coordinates and species. The program adopts a linear atom-centered decomposition of the electron density, which makes it highly transferable across diverse atomistic configurations sharing similar chemical environments. Because of this representation choice, SALTED is naturally interfaced with state-of-the-art electronic-structure programs based on atomic orbitals, namely CP2K, FHI-aims, and PySCF, from which reference electron-density data can be generated and used to train a model. The learning algorithm is based on a symmetry-adapted extension of Gaussian process r…

item.title: 利用局域化学构型上的主动学习准确预测力学性能：以WC-Co复合材料为例
item.description:
📚 ScienceDirect
该研究围绕利用局域化学构型上的主动学习方法预测WC-Co复合材料力学性能展开。工作发表在《计算材料科学》上，作者为Faridun N. Jalolov、Viktor S. Baidyshev和Alexander G. Kvashnin。由于所提供信息仅包含题名、作者和出版元数据，具体方法、结果及结论需查阅原文。

item.title: Oscillating Heat Transfer Prediction in Porous Structures Using Generative AI-Assisted Explainable Machine Learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Lichang Zhu, Laura Schaefer, Leitao Chen, Ben Xu
arXiv:2509.11863v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Predicting and interpreting thermal performance under oscillating flow in porous structures remains a critical challenge due to the complex coupling between fluid dynamics and geometric features. A wide range of porous structures with diverse topologies were synthesized using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network with gradient penalty (wGAN-GP), significantly expanding the design space. High-fidelity thermal data were then generated through LBM simulations across vario…

item.title: 通过平坦磁性能量景观解析RuO₂磁基态争议
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tianxiao Liang, Fanhan Kong, Jijun Zhao, Xue Jiang
金红石结构RuO₂是反铁尔磁性的著名候选材料，但其实验磁基态存在非磁态与反铁尔磁有序两种相互矛盾的报道。本文建立了环境依赖型自旋—晶格理论框架，将局域海森堡交换、通过朗道自旋涨落描述的巡游斯通纳磁性以及自旋轨道耦合介导的自旋—晶格相互作用统一起来。机器学习参数化和大规模蒙特卡洛模拟显示，RuO₂具有极其平坦的磁性能量景观，非磁态与多种反铁尔磁构型近乎简并；缺陷等扰动可通过改变局域交换作用选择不同基态，而自旋轨道耦合主要控制奈尔矢量方向和稳定性。

item.title: Predicting the process parameters for torque and thrust force in wood plastic composite drilling using machine learning algorithms

Wood Plastic Composite has become increasingly notable in domestic and industrial applications. The excessive thrust force and torque generated during drilling lead to poor surface finish and potential damage to the work materials. The drilling experiments were performed using Taguchi's L27 orthogonal array, with drilling parameters (N, f, and d) as inputs and thrust force and torque as output responses. item.title: Influence of Extruded Filament Shape on Buildability in 3D Concrete Printing: A Geometry-Informed Deep Learning-FEM Approach
item.description:

👤 Giacomo Rizzieri, Saif-Ur-Rehman, Jörg F. Unger, Annika Robens-Radermacher
arXiv:2609.04028v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The geometric morphology of deposited filaments can significantly influence the structural performance and stability of 3D concrete-printed (3DCP) structures. This study proposes a geometry-informed modelling framework that integrates the deep-learning-based filament shape prediction tool ShapeGen3DCP with a layer-activation FEM approach to investigate the effect of realistic filament geometries on buildability. The framework generates geometry-aware numerical models directly from material and process parameters, eliminating the need for experimental filament characteri…

item.title: 利用多指标Bell多项式计算物理信息神经网络中的高阶混合导数
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Fumihiro Imoto
针对高阶偏微分方程的物理信息神经网络需要计算混合输入导数及其关于网络参数的梯度。本文组织多变量Faà di Bruno公式的前向递推，并在预先给定的向下封闭多指标集合上实现显式反向传播，从而避免嵌套计算图，同时仅携带微分算子所需的导数。该方法通过独立Taylor喷流实现、符号检验和有限差分验证了七阶以内的导数与损失梯度，并在单核CPU上计算了四个输入、七阶以内的330个混合导数及相应梯度而未出现若干嵌套实现中的内存故障。

item.title: Linearized subspace refinement framework to expose hidden accuracy in trained neural networks
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wenbo Cao, Weiwei Zhang
arXiv:2601.13989v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Neural networks trained by gradient-based methods often exhibit optimization-induced accuracy plateaus in scientific machine learning tasks. We present Linearized Subspace Refinement (LSR), an architecture-agnostic post-training framework that exploits the local linearized model at a fixed trained state. By solving a reduced direct least-squares problem in a Jacobian-defined low-dimensional space, LSR computes a subspace-optimal linearized correction and yields a refined predictor with markedly improved accuracy. Across function approximation, data-driven operator learning, physics-informed operator fine-tuning, and noisy inverse problems, LSR shows that standard nonlinear training can remain far above this subspace-attainable error leve…

item.title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model-Assisted Title­­ and Abstract Screening for Systematic Reviews: Method Evaluation and Validation
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Dimitri Belenki, Alexander Astanin, Dan Baaken, Heinrich A. M. Leymann, Felix Meyer, Blanka Pophof 等7位作者
Background The yearly number of publications in many fields, including research on potential health effects of electromagnetic fields (EMF), has steadily risen, making systematic reviews (SRs) increasingly laborious. Automating the title and abstract screening phase using large language models (LLMs) is a promising solution. The most promising workflows were validated on eight independent SR datasets, focusing on EMF and non-EMF research domains. item.title: Computing stable configurations of confined smectic liquid crystals with a deep variational framework
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yuchen Xie, Baoming Shi, Yucen Han, Lei Zhang
arXiv:2609.03389v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Smectic liquid crystals are layered liquid-crystalline phases characterized by orientational order and periodic density modulation. Although their structures can be modeled using continuum theories, computing stable configurations remains challenging in complex geometries, particularly when the high-frequency density modulations associated with smectic layering should be resolved. We propose a deep variational framework (DVF) for computing these configurations within the modified Landau--de Gennes model, in which the coupled orientational and positional order parameters are represented on a regular reference domain while physical confinement is incorporated through coordinate mappings. item.description:

👤 James Brooke, Emyr Clement, Maciej Glowacki, Sudarshan Paramesvaran, Jeronimo Segal
arXiv:2503.09428v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The implementation of convolutional neural networks in programmable logic, for applications in fast online event selection at hadron colliders, is studied. In particular, an approach based on full event images for classification is studied, including hardware-aware optimisation of the network architecture, and evaluation of physics performance using simulated data. item.title: Q-Edge: Symmetry-Reduced Quantum Simulation of Structured Extreme Dependence
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hongrui Zhang, Paolo Recchia, Ying Chen
arXiv:2609.03706v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: High-dimensional simulation of multivariate extremes is fundamentally limited by the combinatorial complexity of dependence, often more than by the scarcity of extreme observations. We show that symmetry admits a lossless orbit-space representation that preserves structured extreme dependence while replacing an exponentially large dependence space with a compact set of symmetry classes. Based on this principle, we develop Q-Edge (Quantum Extreme Dependence Engine), a symmetry-reduced quantum framework that operates directly in orbit space, enabling scalable simulation and digital twins of structured extreme systems. item.title: Parameter-performance scaling of hybrid quantum-classical policies for demand-charge-aware battery control
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Eunsung Oh
Hybrid quantum-classical models are often proposed as compact alternatives to classical neural networks; however, the claim that they require fewer parameters has rarely been tested across full model size ranges against strong classical baselines. In this study, this claim was tested on a realistic energy-control task: 15-min, full-month control of behind-the-meter batteries that must minimize commercial electricity demand charges using 549 simulated office buildings under a standardized utility tariff. Three policy families—a classical neural network and two hybrid quantum-circuit variants sharing the same inputs and control head—were trained by behavioral cloning from a perfect-foresight optimizer and compared at four parameter budgets on a locked held-out test set. item.description:

👤 Eunhan Ka, Ludovic Leclercq, Satish V. Ukkusuri
arXiv:2605.08028v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Traffic state estimation from sparse fixed sensors is challenging because physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) tend to over-smooth sharp transitions admitted by the Lighthill-Whitham--Richards (LWR) model. This study proposes Two-Stage Domain Decomposition Physics-Informed Neural Networks (TSDD-PINN), an observation-aligned framework for LWR-based offline speed-field reconstruction. The framework supports spatial, temporal, and space--time refinement. Matched direction analysis shows that spatial refinement has the lowest mean error and less than half the training time of space--time refinement in the tested setting, while temporal refinement is faster. A global parent PINN is first trained. In the controlled spatial implementation,…

item.title: 基于物理信息高斯过程的非线性系统周期解自适应学习
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Yixin Li, Zhong-Rong Lu, Dahao Yang, Zechang Zheng, Jike Liu, Li Wang
本文提出一种物理信息高斯过程（PIGP），用于自适应计算非线性动力系统的周期解。该方法利用专门构造的物理信息周期核函数和均值函数近似周期解，并结合控制方程配置与迭代线性化获得解及其均值和协方差信息。研究还提出基于方差或残差准则的自适应配置策略，数值算例表明，该方法具有较高的精度、稳健性和效率，并在相同精度下优于谐波平衡法。

Long-period naturalistic emotion in stable small groups exhibits hallmarks of complex systems -- multi-stable attractors, weak chaos, long-range memory, and sparse heterogeneous coupling -- invisible to conventional short-clip facial-emotion analysis. CARDIO-Affect treats individual emotion as a multi-stable nonlinear stochastic dynamical system and group emotion as a sparsely-coupled network with emergent macrostates, formalised through six propositions and four pillars: (i) statistical mechanics with neural-parameterised Hamiltonian SDE over asymmetric pote…

item.title: 基于机器学习的CdSnP2集成太阳能—光电探测器件设计与可解释优化
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Md. Alamin Hossain Pappu, Kazi Abrar Shafin, Mainul Hossain, Jaker Hossain
本文利用结合机器学习与SCAPS-1D的混合框架，研究采用CdS窗口层和CuGaSe2背表面场层的CdSnP2集成太阳能电池—光电探测器件，并优化各层的厚度、掺杂浓度和缺陷密度。机器学习引导的优化从13种候选结构中确定n-CdS/p-CdSnP2/p+-CGS为最优构型；加入200纳米CGS背表面场层后，效率由20.67%提高至32.69%，响应度由0.53 A W⁻¹提高至0.72 A W⁻¹，探测率由2.51×10¹⁴ Jones提高至1.78×10¹⁶ Jones。SHAP分析表明，窗口层/吸收层和吸收层/背表面场界面的能带偏移设计，以及吸收层性质，是决定器件性能的主要因素。

item.title: 热历史通过结构与动力学控制铅卤钙钛矿的光电响应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Milos Dubajic, Xia Liang, Johan Klarbring, Yang Lu, Thomas A. Selby, Erik Fransson 等29位作者
铅卤钙钛矿是有前景的光伏、发光和探测材料，但稳定性已成为其进一步发展的主要障碍。研究者结合单晶X射线与中子弥散散射、机器学习辅助分子动力学、八面体倾斜模型和高光谱光致发光，发现几乎所有组成都存在由相关八面体倾斜形成的动态纳米畴，这些局域涨落会破坏晶体学对称性。A位阳离子决定纳米畴的对称性、形状和各向异性，卤素决定动态无序与相变序列，而热历史也会使名义相同的组成进入具有不同局域有序的晶体相，因此热历史应成为与组成同等重要的器件设计变量。

item.title: Gradients Know What Outcomes Don't: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning with Gradient-Aligned Rewards

👤 Leqi Zheng, Jinbo Su, Fang Niu, Chaokun Wang, Weiping Wang, Jiajun Zhang 等11位作者
arXiv:2609.03342v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) drives chain-of-thought reasoning in large language models, yet its binary outcome reward cannot distinguish among correct trajectories. item.title: Speak for Me: Giving LLMs the Situational Awareness to Participate in a Meeting
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Muneeb Khan, Frederic Kirstein, Terry Ruas, Bela Gipp
arXiv:2609.03923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In online meeting delegation, LLM agents fail to recognize when to speak. With no structured way to track stances, coverage, and floor, they miss the moments where they should contribute. Prompt-only delegates stay silent on 51.4% of the absent participant's talking opportunities on the AMI corpus. A Predictor forecasts how the conversation will continue. A Controller decides whether to speak and which proposition to surface. item.title: 由非磁性组分产生的莫尔诱导反铁尔磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv

item.title: 通过局域磁矩磁性实现室温拓扑霍尔效应的策略

item.title: 跨布拉维晶格空间的偶极有序：分类、自旋波与四吸引子相图

item.title: 利用铁磁与普通金属电压探针直接电检测β-钨和铂中自旋霍尔效应产生的自旋化学势

item.title: 应变诱导轴向规范场与内禀能带拓扑在有隙节点环磁电导中的相互作用
